design_implementation_hints: To prevent null-reference exceptions which may occur while trying to access or manipulate an object or reference that is null.
To prevent undefined behaviour by verifying the existence of an object or reference before using it.
Range checks of input and output data.
Checks on permissible value ranges when entering a software function.

examples: Using a reference model of the desired behaviour.

design_implementation_hints: Verify that the system is in a valid state before performing specific operations.
Check that transitions between states are logical and allowed.
Confirm that variables and calculations do not exceed predefined limits or boundaries.
Guard against integer overflows, buffer overflows, or other conditions that may lead to unpredictable behaviour.
Validate that timing constraints are met, especially in real-time systems.
Ensure that tasks or processes are executed within specified time intervals.
Ensure that configuration settings are within acceptable ranges defined by AUTOSAR or user.
Validate that the configuration of system components is consistent within Qorix Adaptive.

Stack canaries are checked before function return to make sure they have not been modified, for example as a result of a buffer overflow on stack allocated variables. Any modification to the stack canary on the stack will result in process abort.
Monitoring of program execution by an external element such as an ASIC or another software element performing platform health watchdog monitoring.
